product_summary: Real product lines per own website (advaitindustries.com, accessed for this check): (1) Hexachloroethane C2Cl6 — degassing/smoke/vet use; (2) AD-DEGASAR degassing tablets; (3) AD-COVERFLUX, AD-GRANULATED FLUX, fused fluxes; (4) AD-ALKALI REMOVER, AD-MGR magnesium remover, AD-GRAIN REFINER tablets; (5) AD MASTER ALLOYS — AlTi5B1, AlSr 5/10/15%, AlTi 5/10%, AlMn 10/15%, AlSi 30%, AlB 8/10%, AlCr 10%, supplied as waffle, cast bar, stick, coil, ingot; (6) AD-METALS (RAW) — silicon metal 553/441/2202, magnesium 99.99%, manganese 99.00%, strontium metal 99.99%; (7) AD-CERAMIC FORM FILTER 20/30/40 PPI (200x200x22 mm, 8/12/15 inch), AD-CERAMIC SHAPES, coating refractories; (8) AD-GRAPHITE CASTING. Declared 760521 (aluminium alloy wire, >7 mm) covers only the 'coil' form of master alloys — a narrow slice of the actual range.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site claims 'manufacturer & exporter' of hexachloroethane and foundry products (own plant at Plot No. 11, GIDC Dhrol, Jamnagar, Gujarat), but the raw metals block (silicon 553/441/2202, Mg 99.99%, Mn 99.00%, Sr 99.99%) is standard traded commodity, so a mixed manufacturer/trader profile is likely. No customs line reviewed here, so the manufacturer claim is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: HS 760521 is only partially correct: it fits the aluminium-alloy master-alloy coil form, but the company's core declared business (hexachloroethane, foundry fluxes/degassing tablets, ceramic foam filters, raw silicon/magnesium/manganese/strontium) is not covered by 7605 at all. Per project rule 3 the company is kept and the code corrected — verdict accepted_hs_corrected, not rejected. Industry label 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is a misclassification: the primary product is a chlorinated organic chemical (HS 2903.19) plus metallurgical chemical preparations (3824.99); metals are secondary. Trader signs: raw metals sold by standard grades (553/441/2202) with no smelter reference, and 'AD-' private-label branding across unrelated product families, typical of a formulator/trader rather than a single-process plant. Product lines missing from the declaration: hexachloroethane, fluxes/degassers/grain refiners, ceramic foam filters and refractories, graphite products, unwrought Si/Mg/Mn/Sr. All product data above is from the company's own catalogue pages — no customs line was available in this task, therefore every line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. No registry, revenue or shipment data researched per role scope; PAN/CIN not public on the site (null).
